h:
该集合由三个工作流程组成，旨在使混合模型成为一个有趣且富有创意的过程。通过引入严格的随机性，您可以探索各种可能性并找到完美的混合。

工作流程概述：

1.第一阶段工作流程：从这里开始生成检查点的多种变体。此阶段允许您尝试不同的组合并发现最有效的组合。

2.多合一工作流程：使用此工作流程来测试生成的检查点并确定最有希望的检查点。选择最佳检查点后，您可以使用您选择的 Loras 对其进行微调。

3.第 2 阶段工作流程：在最后阶段，加载获胜检查点，输入 Loras 及其最佳值，并保存您的最终创作。此步骤将您的自定义混合基础检查点细化为精湛的最终产品。

这些工作流程处于版本 1 中，用途广泛，足以用于一般目的和 NSFW 目的。由于这是我第一次上传工作流程，恳请您理解并欢迎任何反馈。

注意：我强烈建议使用 ComfyUI Manager，因为工作流程依赖于多个扩展才能正常运行。

享受创作过程！

o.en:
This collection consists of three workflows designed to make blending models an enjoyable and creative process. By introducing disciplined randomness, you can explore a wide range of possibilities and find the perfect blend.

Workflow Overview:

1.Stage 1 Workflow:Start here to generate multiple variations of checkpoints. This stage allows you to experiment with different combinations and discover what works best.

2.All-In-One Workflow:Use this workflow to test the generated checkpoints and identify the most promising ones. Once you've selected the best checkpoint(s), you can fine-tune them using the Loras of your choice.

3.Stage 2 Workflow:In this final stage, load the winning checkpoint, input the Loras and their optimal values, and save your ultimate creation. This step refines your custom blended base checkpoint into a masterful final product.

These workflows are in Version 1 and are versatile enough to be used for both general and NSFW purposes. As this is my first time uploading workflows, I kindly ask for your understanding and welcome any feedback.

Note:I highly recommend using ComfyUI Manager, as the workflows rely on multiple extensions to function correctly.

Enjoy the creative process!
